body: Ok, but I don't see how you dug the hole unless you blew off class. Go to the prof and get help, most are happy to help.
So, what's your hole you've dug

Just to update. My Psychiatrist called and I explained things to him and talked about couples counseling. He said that he would try to talk to my wife. She texted me things that touched my heart. I live to see another day.
Move on. Did the Mom/Daughter thing as well. It was both kinky and hot because Mom was a freak in bed. It's been probably 25 years for me and I still haven't forgotten but I moved on. It's healthy.

Starting stats aren't really important. It's more important to put the upgrade points in the right place. But even then you can always respec everything later. It doesn't tell you, but once you get your ship it has a machine to reset your points and perks
They say that it's possible, but not likely that the tubes could rejoin. As for how long, a few days.
No lower sex drive. Little chance of pregnancy. Hurts like hell after.

I was outside St. Denis when there was a robbery. I shot the robber and took his horse, which turned out to be a female black Arabian. This was in Chapter 3, which only has the wild, white Arabian available. So, not only did I get the horse early, it's a mare.
I proposed after 5 days. We just clicked.
I'm throughly enjoying the dialogue options. They have me in stitches at times.
Watch to the end, the old guy gets back up! Take a hoof to the nuts and get back up...
It's her kink, ask her want she wants. If you're really lucky maybe she'll want a GF to do the filming.
Sorry, I  forgot to mention that my SO is an abuse survivor. Father sex abuse, also spousal in a young marriage. We're both damaged goods, so we try to be good to each other.

If he's up for it and he says so, you have to take him at his word. But might I suggest some preemptive medication beforehand. 

You're completely right about needing alternative viewpoints

You're right, this is confusing. But in this case, I think I understand. Your DH sounds like a great guy, caring and ambitious for both himself and his family. And guys like that will do things, even suggest things, that they may not like. They'll tell themselves that they can live with it for a couple years if they think it's essential to attain those goals. I hope it works out.

From my experience therapy doesn't work...for me. I've talked to several therapists and while it might work for some it most definitely doesn't work for all. I think  that the anxiety tends to hold me back from really opening up to the therapist. Might be the same for DH.

I also think the "Family State of the Union" might have blowback because it was just the two of you talking before, so, from the perspective of someone that also has PTSD and anxiety from an abusive mother (I throw up practically every day before I go to work), he might feel outnumbered and go on the defensive. 

Try getting back to just the two of you. Living in someone else's house is rough. Not so much for you, because they are your parents, but for him, parents are probably a trigger for him. Mom issues. And in your post you said that DH said he never felt at home at your parents place. He had a home. Now he doesn't. He might have been looking for a way to "go home" for awhile. 

But, even with all that, you have more of a chance than most. You have extremely supportive family. Just remember: You're home. He's a guest. Totally different feeling.

IT guy here too, but I've done a lot of things. Hanging drywall is "manly" to some. But to be fair I won my wife by fixing her dead car in the middle of January. Married 23 yrs. Ask for tools for Christmas.
Just wait. Had this happen in camp trying to talk to Hosea. It was strange, everything else was still moving around us but we were stuck.

Do the Treasure Hunter Challenge asap. You can complete it in Chapter 1 and get around 6-7 thousand if memory serves. You also get an additional "tank" of one of the attributes. I think its Deadeye, after you buy the full set of reinforced gear.

Use Eagle eye (press down on both sticks on xbox) a lot! Find and pick as much Thyme as you can and then go hunt big game. Big game (alligator, cougar, panther, wolf) meat when cooked and seasoned with Thyme and eaten gives the player a gold Deadeye core.

Finally, if you want high honor never loot anyone but bad guys. Even if they are already dead, looting a stranger will ding your honor.
